notes: Printed: 'Double strike. Vigilance. Trample.' Giant Growth makes the Vindicator 4/4; a 2/2 blocks it. First-strike damage: lethal 2 to the blocker and, by trample, the excess 2 to the opponent (the trample ask gives the blocker 0 extra). The blocker dies. Regular damage: 4 more to the opponent (trample, blocker gone). Opponent 20 -> 14. Without trample the first-strike step could not assign past the blocker (CR 702.19). Vigilance: untapped.
